messages:
raj: FYI — saw a billing spike in invoices for 12:05-12:15 UTC. +1.3M tokens for multiple tenants. Looks correlated with a routing fallback to us-east-1 during the region blip. digging.

marta: is that duplication or real usage? any sign of retry storms?

raj: early logs look like duplicate metering events emitted for the same client request but with different route fingerprints. example: 
```
METEREVENT id=req_9f2 route=eu-west model=gpt-neo tokens=1024 fingerprint=abc123
METEREVENT id=req_9f2 route=us-east model=gpt-neo tokens=1024 fingerprint=xyz456
```

ian: aha — fingerprint changes on fallback. our fingerprint currently includes route_id + seq_bucket, so fallback causes a different fingerprint and we don't dedupe.

sasha: can we plumb a canonical id through the proxy (x-canonical-request-id) so fingerprint stays stable across hops? alternatively dedupe in aggregator by (client_id, original_req_id, token_count) within a small window.

kevin: dedupe in aggregator is heavier but safer long-term. short-term hotfix: make proxy preserve original idempotency header if present, and if not, set a deterministic canonical id before fanout. that should stop double-counting for retries.

marta: CS already saw tenant spikes and got paged. dash noise was bad. we should add a "metering-safe" toggle in rollout UX so teams can gate fingerprint/route changes until dedupe is enabled. current rollout UI only supports traffic % which isn't enough.

amanda: for invoices/backfill we'll need a reconciliation job to collapse duplicates by canonical_id within a 5m window. I can draft SQL.

billing-bot: NOTE: invoice pipeline ingested 1,346,200 extra tokens for tenant acme-corp between 2026-03-19T12:05:00Z and 2026-03-19T12:15:00Z — flagged for review.

raj: proposed plan:
1) hotfix proxy to preserve canonical idempotency (patch + rollback plan)
2) add aggregator dedupe rule (config flag, 5m window)
3) console: add metering-safe toggle on rollout page
4) run backfill to reconcile duplicates older than 24h
comments?

ian: +1. hotfix PR ready, need ops approval to deploy to canary then global. deploy command: 
```
./deploy.sh proxy --env=canary --sha=proxy-fix-fingerprint
```

sasha: add unit/integration tests for fingerprint invariance across fallback paths. also update SDKs to send x-client-id when available.

kevin: ops note — bump fanout timeouts when we deploy this, earlier ordering issues in fanout + fallback increased chance of duplicate ingests.

marta: I'll put a note on the tenant dashboards explaining temporary noise so CS doesn't escalate while we triage.

amanda: starting SQL draft now: 
```
WITH dup AS (
  SELECT canonical_id, count(*) as cnt, sum(tokens) as tokens_sum
  FROM metering.events
  WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  GROUP BY canonical_id
  HAVING count(*) > 1
)
-- then update invoice_lines to use deduped tokens_sum
```

billing-bot: Backfill job scheduled: reconcile-dup-2026-03-19 queued.

raj: owners/timeline — hotfix in next 30m (raj), canary monitor 1h (ian), global push + aggregator flag (kevin), backfill (amanda), dashboard note (marta), SDK/tests (sasha). ping me for any blockers.

ian: I'm oncall, will watch CPU and aggregation lag during backfill. ping immediately if anything spikes.

marta: :thumbsup:
